page.layout: One page of text, one column, centred; running head at top with page number at right; catchword at lower right. Left margin shows cropped fragments of a facing page (not transcribed).

main_text.p: illa Musæis Scholisque continetur: videri gestit, & ad evolandum prurit. Adde porrò, supervacaneo sumptu bona patria lacerari, & sæpe alienum æs grande conflari: Dum in vestium formis quotidie novi quid effingitur, quod assumendum est, & vix assumptum antiquatur: Nec per se sola culpam habet vestis; Sunt hujus individui comites, qui plerumque lautius haberi volunt, quam ipsa: Quantum abliguriunt convivia! quantum expellunt Sphæristeria! quantum dilapidat phalerata per urbem obequitatio! quantum pessumdant vespertina tripudia! quantum ad Dominæ fores explodit noctura cum fulgetris musica!

page.notes: Left margin fragments belong to the facing page and are not transcribed. Scan partly shows show-through from the reverse page (faint lines below the text), omitted. Catchword "Quæ-" is printed at lower right; it is also the final word of the text, so it is given once as catchword.
